_comment: One entry per benchmarked model. 'backend' picks the provider: openrouter / huggingface / copilot (openai-compatible; copilot is the local Copilot API Gateway, streamed) or local (llamacpp-jni, GGUF under modelDir). 'settings' are copied verbatim into the srcMorph aiDefinition; the common settings below apply first. 'origin' marks the June 2026 benchmark models.

models.name: Gemma 4 31B it (reasoning off)
models.note: reasoning switched off with reasoning.effort none; at effort low the route reasons as well (163 reasoning tokens for a one-line test method)

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B
models.note: reasoning tokens count against max_tokens; at the common 4096 most answers came back empty

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B (reasoning off)
models.note: reasoning switched off with reasoning.effort none; at effort low the same route spent the output budget on reasoning

models.name: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
models.note: reasoning tokens count against max_tokens; at the common 4096 most answers came back empty

models.name: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (reasoning off)
models.note: reasoning switched off with reasoning.effort none; at effort low the same route spent the output budget on reasoning

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B (reasoning off)
models.note: reasoning switched off with reasoning.effort none; at effort low the route reasons as well (25 reasoning tokens for a one-line test method)

models.name: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash
models.note: GitHub Copilot through the Copilot API Gateway VS Code extension (docs/copilot-api-gateway.md); max_input_tokens 127790, so the window stays below it

models.name: GPT-6 Luna (Copilot)
models.note: the same model as gpt-6-luna, through GitHub Copilot instead of OpenRouter: shows what the route changes

models.name: Grok 4.7
models.note: through GitHub Copilot: on OpenRouter (x-ai/grok-4.7, reasoning mandatory) xAI refused the run after 8 files with 403 'This service is not available in your region'

models.name: Gemma 4 12B it (Q4_K_M, thinking off)
models.note: llama.cpp renders Gemma 4 with thinking on unless told otherwise; with it on, every Java file of gemma-4-12b spent the whole 4096-token budget reasoning
